about: Three known voices beside a busy road, one of them quiet and far away, and a one word reply.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Can you hear me all right? The trucks are really loud on this stretch of road.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Just about. Let's walk down to the corner where it's a bit quieter.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Good plan. Watch the gutter on the way, it's full of water from last night.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Wait for me, I'm just locking the car and grabbing my umbrella.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Right, we're here. So what time does the bus leave for the city?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Twenty past, if it's on time, which it almost never is on a Friday.
